verdict.rationale: Notion is a workspace, docs and knowledge product. Its agents work on pages and databases, not on code changes, so a mobile code-review flow with line-level diff comments is outside its category. Nothing in the evidence shows Notion offering code diffs, line-level code comments, or coding-agent iteration. The page comments, webhooks, Agent API sessions and GitHub sync item are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
